ingest_surface_resolution.resolution: Continue the active append-only main projection rather than manufacture a second ingest authority; preserve the missing expected inbox as an implementation-surface mismatch.

forensic_findings.claim: The donor section named EffectGate explicitly never blocks Claude Code tools. ABGELEHNT, WIEDERHOLUNG and UNGEPRUEFT are bookkeeping states; the tool runs regardless. The source names an older external wache-koenig.py as the blocking guard.
forensic_findings.frankenstein_2_0_action: Do not reuse this one-to-one as effect authority; split policy/admission recording from actual enforcement and verified effect authority.

forensic_findings.claim: _beleg_pruefen() rejects an effect proof only when status equals legacy lowercase 'fehler'. Current Phase-2 states such as FEHLGESCHLAGEN, ABGELEHNT, WIEDERHOLUNG and UNGEPRUEFT therefore are not rejected and can satisfy reconcile().
forensic_findings.impact: A work package can be promoted to stand='fertig' by an effect row whose current status does not establish successful admitted execution.
forensic_findings.frankenstein_2_0_action: Use an explicit allowlist of receipt states bound to exact effect/invocation/generation; failed, denied, unchecked and unresolved duplicate states fail closed.

forensic_findings.claim: test:<exit_code>:<description> is accepted solely when the supplied exit_code string equals '0'; it is not bound to an observed process, runner, command hash, source SHA, timestamp, receipt or output digest.
forensic_findings.frankenstein_2_0_action: Replace textual test claims with immutable execution-receipt identity and source/command/environment binding.

forensic_findings.claim: The verifier comment says Phase-2 landing will make effect checking automatically stricter, but Phase-2 states are present while the executable predicate still checks only status != legacy 'fehler'.
forensic_findings.frankenstein_2_0_action: Executable predicates outrank migration comments; add successor-dynamic state-vocabulary tests.

forensic_findings.claim: File-edit verification hashes resulting file bytes, while Bash verification hashes stdout/stderr and checks exit status. That is an execution/tool-result receipt, not proof of arbitrary external-world side effects.
forensic_findings.frankenstein_2_0_action: Separate execution receipt from world-effect verification and preserve UNKNOWN external outcomes until observed.

forensic_findings.claim: PreToolUse writes one active_turns.effect_id per session and PostToolUse reads that slot. If same-session tool invocations can interleave, a later PreToolUse could overwrite the correlation pointer before an earlier PostToolUse consumes it.
forensic_findings.counterhypothesis: The host lifecycle may serialize hook pairs strongly enough that this interleaving is unreachable.
forensic_findings.falsifier: Trace overlapping tool calls under the real hook scheduler and prove exact invocation-id-to-effect-id pairing.
forensic_findings.frankenstein_2_0_action: Prefer immutable invocation/call identity over a mutable session-wide current-effect pointer.

forensic_findings.claim: The daily completed-work recheck intentionally reuses _beleg_pruefen(); this avoids verifier drift but propagates the same weak effect-status and unbound test:0 semantics.
forensic_findings.frankenstein_2_0_action: Keep one verifier, but make it typed, receipt-bound and successor-dynamic.

architecture_delta.new_constraint: Frankenstein-2.0 must represent ADMISSION_DECISION, ENFORCEMENT_DECISION, EXECUTION_RECEIPT, WORLD_EFFECT_VERIFICATION and COMPLETION_EVIDENCE as distinct typed states/identities.
architecture_delta.effect_authority_rule: Historical stern.py EffectGate is a donor for provenance/idempotency/outcome-journal ideas only, not enforcement semantics.
architecture_delta.completion_rule: Only exact admissible receipts may close work packages; failed, denied, unchecked, stale, unbound-test and unknown-world-outcome states cannot satisfy completion.
architecture_delta.identity_rule: Bind effects to immutable invocation identity in addition to session/episode/generation.

contradictions_preserved: EntityOS requires deterministic EffectGate+EffectJournal real-effect authority, while donor stern.py explicitly says its named EffectGate never blocks tools.
The completion verifier documents a future stricter Phase-2 behavior that the current executable predicate does not implement.
next_exact_gate: Resolve Git introduction/supersession chronology for posttool-only logging -> Phase-2 nonblocking admission bookkeeping -> current completion verifier, then inspect actual blocking wache-koenig and hook scheduling for reusable Frankenstein-2.0 enforcement/correlation mechanisms.
